title: 第九章 脚踹袁术

content_zh:
重赏之下必有勇夫，越来越多的西凉军开始拼命，这可是一步登天的机会。
战场的局势再次陷入了胶着，孙坚勇猛，西凉军精锐，一时难解难分。
“随本将军杀！”刚刚赶到的吕布见孙坚岌岌可危，率领骑兵直取华雄，大喝道：“华雄，拿命来。”
“吕布！”华雄眼神一紧，一刀荡开祖茂一击，掉马逃向军中，若问联军中他最怕的是谁，莫过于眼前的吕布，此人可是当初力战西凉军三员大将游刃有余的主儿。
原本作为西凉军大将的华雄不服吕布武艺，与其单挑，结果很惨，没出三招，差点惨死在吕布戟下，他深深的明白两人的武艺根本不在一个档次，所以每次面对吕布，他根本没有任何战意。
“杀！”见华雄胆怯，吕布手中方天画戟一挥，身后两千骑兵如同下山猛虎冲向华雄军，并州骑兵皆是精锐，再加上马镫之利，杀的西凉骑兵节节败退。
华雄见手下的骑兵在吕布手中吃了大亏，只能无奈的开始撤退，骑兵的死伤是不能容忍的，就算是董卓，拥有的骑兵数量也不多。
“多谢吕将军救命之恩，先前在下以小人之心度君子之福，还望吕将军莫怪。”满身血迹的孙坚在马上抱拳道。
“孙将军见外了，你我同为联军，理当携手共退敌军。”吕布向身后骑兵大喊道：“随本将军杀敌。”
看着两支骑兵厮杀在一起，孙坚心中有一股组建骑兵的冲动，之前袭营，若不是凉州骑兵的冲锋，他手下的军队也不会败的这么快。
双方骑兵纠缠在一起，孙坚急忙收拢兵马。
冲杀一阵之后，曹性收拢兵马上前道：“我军亡一百三十余人，伤四百余人，敌军至少亡三百人。”
吕布感觉心中一疼“找到兄弟们的尸体，好生安葬，死者做好登记。”
“诺。”曹性抱拳道，他对并州军的战绩很满意，董卓麾下铁骑的精锐天下闻名，己方骑兵能够杀死两倍多的敌人，放在以前是很难想象的。
“吕将军麾下果然是精锐之师，凉州铁骑不如也。”孙坚话语中满是羡慕。
“孙将军乃是受了小人算计，才导致大败，否则华雄岂会如此容易得手。”吕布笑道。
“袁术枉为名门之后，大敌当前，竟然克扣粮草，导致我军大败，此番回去，定然讨要说法。”孙坚咬牙切齿道。
“孙将军，莫非是之前得罪了袁术？”吕布疑问道。
“不可能。”孙坚断然道。
“哦，那就有些奇怪了。”

孙坚心中一惊，想到了一种可能，他虽然与袁术无仇，却与袁术治下相邻，莫非他是想要借着董卓之手削弱自己的实力？
华雄见形势逆转急忙收拢兵马，退回关内，上书董卓，详细述说了如何攻破孙坚大军以及吕布率兵救援的细节。
吕布的提醒让孙坚长了个心眼，看来之前自己表现的有些过头了，引起了某些人的猜忌。
孙坚脸色铁青的与吕布并肩走入盟军大帐，还未等上首的袁绍出言安抚，就指着袁术大骂道：“袁公路，本将军两万大军死伤过半，皆是你的缘故，为何不发粮草，今日如果不能给本将军一个交代，哼。”
“文台息怒，息怒，昨晚听到文台败于华雄之手，不若先且回营安歇。”袁绍宽慰道。
不提还好，孙坚顿时火冒三丈“若不是袁术小儿不发粮草，我军怎能有此一败？”
“孙文台，你打了败仗反倒赖在我的头上了。”袁术起身冷哼道。
“袁将军，孙将军军中缺少粮草，催粮的人来了好几次，为何不发粮草？”吕布盯着袁术冷笑道。
“匹夫，这里有你插嘴的份儿吗？”孙坚号称猛虎，在破黄巾的时候闯下偌大的威名，武艺高强，袁术怕孙坚，可不代表怕吕布，张嘴就骂。
“袁术小儿，有如此口舌，为何不去攻打董卓？”吕布眼神一紧，怒火上涌，好歹自己这副身体也是绝世猛将，竟然让袁术看扁了，而且还是一个克扣粮草的败类。
曹性高顺分别站在吕布左右两侧，怒视这袁术。
看着吕布怒发冲冠，衣服上的血迹未干，袁术舔了舔嘴唇，心中虽然有些畏惧，仍旧硬挺着“你算什么东西，本将军总督粮草，哪有你讲话的地方？”
“老子带着兵马在前面杀敌，你小子克扣粮草还有理了，不给你点教训，你是不知道马王爷有三只眼。”吕布怒了，上前一脚将袁术踹的连退五六步倒在地上，如果不是孙坚见机的快，拉了一把，恐怕袁术会成为第一个被踢死的诸侯。

content_en:
There must be brave men under the heavy reward, and more and more Xiliang troops are starting to fight hard. This is an opportunity to reach the top in one step.
The situation on the battlefield once again fell into a stalemate. Sun Jian was brave and the Xiliang army was elite. They were inseparable for a while.
"Follow me and kill!" Seeing that Sun Jian was in danger, Lu Bu, who had just arrived, led his cavalry to attack Hua Xiong and shouted: "Hua Xiong, take your life."
"Lu Bu!" Hua Xiong's eyes tightened, he swung Zu Mao away with his sword, turned off his horse and fled towards the army. If he asked who among the coalition forces he was most afraid of, it was none other than Lu Bu in front of him. This man was his master who was able to fight the three generals of the Xiliang Army with ease.
Hua Xiong, who was originally a general of the Xiliang Army, was dissatisfied with Lu Bu's martial arts. Instead of fighting in a duel, the result was disastrous. He failed to make three moves and almost died tragically under Lu Bu's halberd. He deeply understood that the martial arts of the two were not at the same level at all, so every time he faced Lu Bu, he had no intention of fighting at all.
"Kill!" Seeing Hua Xiong's timidity, Lu Bu waved Fang Tian's painted halberd in his hand, and the two thousand cavalry behind him rushed towards Hua Xiong's army like tigers descending from the mountain. The Bingzhou cavalry were all elite, and with the power of stirrups, the Xiliang cavalry was defeated steadily.
Seeing that his cavalry suffered heavy losses at the hands of Lu Bu, Hua Xiong had no choice but to retreat. The casualties of the cavalry were intolerable. Even Dong Zhuo did not have many cavalry.
"Thank you, General Lu, for your life-saving grace. Previously, I judged the blessings of a gentleman with a villain's heart. I hope General Lu will not blame you." Sun Jian, who was covered in blood, cupped his fists on his horse and said.
"General Sun is out. You and I are allied forces and we should work together to repel the enemy." Lu Bu shouted to the cavalry behind him: "Follow me and kill the enemy."
Seeing the two cavalry fighting together, Sun Jian felt the urge to form a cavalry. If it hadn't been for the charge of the Liangzhou cavalry during the previous attack on the camp, his army would not have been defeated so quickly.
The cavalry on both sides were entangled, and Sun Jian hurriedly gathered his troops.
After charging and killing for a while, Cao Xing gathered his troops and marched forward: "Our army has killed more than 130 people and wounded more than 400 people. The enemy's army has lost at least 300 people."
Lu Bu felt a pang in his heart, "Find the bodies of our brothers, bury them properly, and register the dead."
"No," Cao Xing said with his fists clasped. He was very satisfied with the performance of the Bingzhou Army. Dong Zhuo's cavalry was famous all over the world for their elite cavalry. It was unimaginable before that his own cavalry could kill twice as many enemies.
"General Lu's command is indeed an elite force, and the Liangzhou Cavalry is not as good as it is." Sun Jian's words were full of envy.
"General Sun was defeated because of the villain's scheme. Otherwise, how could Hua Xiong succeed so easily?" Lu Bu said with a smile.
"After Yuan Shu became a famous man in vain, the enemy now deprived us of food and grass, causing our army to be defeated. When he goes back this time, he will definitely ask for an explanation." Sun Jian gritted his teeth.
"General Sun, could it be that you offended Yuan Shu before?" Lu Bu asked.
"Impossible." Sun Jian said flatly.
"Oh, that's a little weird."
Sun Jian was shocked and thought of a possibility. Although he had no enmity with Yuan Shu, he was under Yuan Shu's rule. Could it be that he wanted to use Dong Zhuo's hand to weaken his own strength?
Seeing that the situation had reversed, Hua Xiong hurriedly gathered his troops and returned to the pass. He wrote to Dong Zhuo, detailing how to defeat Sun Jian's army and how Lu Bu led his troops to rescue him.
Lu Bu's reminder made Sun Jian think twice. It seemed that he had gone too far before, which aroused the suspicion of some people.
With a pale face, Sun Jian walked into the Allied tent side by side with Lu Bu. Before Yuan Shao could say anything to comfort him, he pointed at Yuan Shu and cursed: "Yuan Gongdao, more than half of my 20,000-strong army were killed or wounded, all because of you. Why don't you distribute food and grass? If you can't give me an explanation today, huh."
"Wentai calm down, calm down. Last night I heard that Wentai was defeated by Hua Xiong, so why not go back to the camp and rest first." Yuan Shao comforted him.
Not to mention, Sun Jian suddenly became furious, "If it weren't for Yuan Shu's son not being given food and fodder, how could our army have been defeated like this?"
"Sun Wentai,You lost the battle and it was all on me. "Yuan Shu stood up and snorted coldly.
"General Yuan, General Sun's army is short of food and grass. The people urging food have been here several times. Why don't they distribute food and grass?" Lu Bu stared at Yuan Shu and sneered.
"Piff, do you have a role to interrupt here? "Sun Jian is known as the fierce tiger. He gained great fame when he broke the Yellow Turban. He is very skilled in martial arts. Yuan Shu is afraid of Sun Jian, but it does not mean that he is afraid of Lu Bu. He will scold him whenever he opens his mouth.
"Young Yuan Shu, with such a arrogant tongue, why don't you attack Dong Zhuo? "Lu Bu's eyes tightened, and his anger surged. After all, he was a peerless warrior with a body that made Yuan Shu look down on him, and he was also a scum who was stealing food and grass.
Cao Xinggao Shun stood on the left and right sides of Lu Bu, glaring at Yuan Shu.
Seeing Lu Bu's anger, the blood on his clothes was still wet, Yuan Shu licked his lips, and although he was a little scared, he still stood up and said, "Who do you think you are? I am the general and the governor of food and grass. How can you speak?" "
"I'm leading my troops to kill the enemy in front. It's okay for you to steal food and grass. If I don't teach you a lesson, you don't know that Lord Ma has three eyes. Lu Bu got angry, stepped forward and kicked Yuan Shu back five or six steps and fell to the ground. If Sun Jian hadn't seen the opportunity quickly and pulled him, Yuan Shu would have been the first prince to be kicked to death.
